workarounds.symptom: [SDK] Scoring key mappings can compare a prediction against itself
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [issue-9461] [SDK] fix: make scoring_key_mapping read unmodified inputs. Target files: sdks/python/src/opik/evaluation/metrics/arguments_helpers.py, sdks/python/tests/unit/evaluation/test_create_scoring_inputs.py. `create_scoring_inputs` applied each `scoring_key_mapping` entry into the same dict it read from. When a mapping target was also the source of a later mapping (e.g. `{"output": "answer", "reference": "output"}`), the later entry read the already-overwritten value, so the score depended on entry order and a wrong answ... (Ref: https://github.com/comet-ml/opik/pull/9479)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: evaluate_threads logs a false ERROR for every skipped thread
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [issue-9403] [SDK] fix: don't log a false error for threads with no feedback scores. Target files: sdks/python/src/opik/evaluation/threads/helpers.py, sdks/python/tests/unit/evaluation/threads/test_helpers.py. `log_feedback_scores` called `log_threads_feedback_scores` for every evaluated thread, including threads that were skipped (no conversation traces) or whose metrics all failed. workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: LLMJudge crashes with TypeError instead of retrying when the judge returns a JSON array
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [issue-9381] [SDK] fix: treat a non-object LLMJudge verdict as a parse failure. Target files: sdks/python/src/opik/evaluation/suite_evaluators/llm_judge/parsers.py, sdks/python/tests/unit/evaluation/suite_evaluators/test_llm_judge.py, sdks/python/tests/unit/evaluation/suite_evaluators/test_llm_judge_parsers.py. `ResponseSchema.parse` built the LLMJudge response model with `**parsed`, so a judge reply that is valid JSON but not an object (a list, a string, `null`, a number) raised a bare `TypeError`.
